item.title: Need advice on finding datasets
item.description: I have an assessment that requires me to find a dataset from a reputable, open-access source (e.g., Pavlovia, Kaggle, OpenNeuro, GitHub, or similar public archive), that should be suitable for a t-test and an ANOVA analysis. I've attempted to explore the aforementioned websites to find datasets, however, I'm having trouble finding appropriate ones (perhaps it's because I don't know how to use them properly), with many of the datasets that I've found providing only minimal information with no links to the actual paper (particularly the ones on kaggle). Does anybody have any advice/tips for finding suitable datasets?
